t1.text: Today in three states: Now, Check-in, Close out

s1.text:
Rules applied on every screen

• Quiet when healthy: risk, failed source, due follow-ups only when they exist.
• One primary action per card: Start focus on the next pick only.
• Risk says why on the card.
• Meetings live on the rail or agenda, never twice.
• Features never sit above stories; a feature without stories is a Needs stories row at the bottom.
• Counts over lists: 2 done, 3 more, 6 to add.
• Fit is amber, one line per block, never red.
• Check-in and Close out change Today's state instead of rebuilding the plan as forms.
